ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; visible surface is approximately 95% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing less than 5% of total fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark contiguous field; high-contrast white blobs are distributed as small (~5-20 pixel) circular rosettes across both lobes; one larger irregular high-intensity cluster is located at the inferior-medial junction (peduncle interface).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; aperture angle is approximately 50 degrees relative to the lobe midlines; notch depth is distinct and clearly demarcated.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct jagged peaks visible on the medial portion of the right lobe and throughout the left lobe trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward convexity on the leading edge terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips; trailing edge follows a subtle sigmoid curve toward the notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular, white-ringed pixel clusters; approximately 20+ distinct rosette formations visible, concentrated primarily in the mid-region of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, unaligned high-intensity linear marks; visible as diagonal scratches on the outer half of the right lobe and horizontal streaks on the inner left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across both lobes; significant white pigment patch at the inferior central junction of the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density and distribution pattern of circular rosette scars providing a high-dimensional spatial 'fingerprint' across the dark ventral field.
